title.narrative: Development of sustainable and resilient cities and communities in Neuquén Argentine Province

description.narrative:
This 10-month project aims to support the Province Government of Neuquén to strengthen inclusive and integrated urban planning and sustainability-oriented public works management in Neuquén. In particular, the proposal focuses on improving the capacities and conditions of the Provincial Direct Administration on generating and using evidence, planning and design as tools for integrating the work across different sectors within the local administration, and integrating the spatial planning with the existing legal and financial framework. Moreover, the project will support the implementation of the objectives of the province's Decree 1320/21 on Promoting Provincial Public Works with Sustainability Criteria.
To achieve the proposed objective, methodologies and tools from UN-Habitat (for outcome 1) and UNOPS (for outcome 2) and UN Women (outputs 1.5 and 2.6) are expected to be used as a starting point for the project. The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the New Urban Agenda (NUA) will also guide the work, and, in addition, the UN Resident Coordination Office in Argentina will act as the overall connection between both to ensure a cohesive approach among the agencies of the system and to link the proposal with the national government.
In the first outcome (By the end of 2023, the government of Neuquén has expanded capacities to implement an integrated and sustainable urban planning strategy together with the municipalities and development commissions of the province), UN-Habitat will support the government of Neuquén with knowledge and resources to strengthen the capacities of the provincial technical teams in the design of municipal plans for sustainable urban development. Using Our City Plan toolbox, planning will be a key instrument to achieve climate adaptation and mitigation, accessible housing, SDG localization and urban crisis response and recovery in the region. UN-Habitat will also assist the local governments in the creation, improvement, maintenance and promotion of streets and public spaces that are socially inclusive, integrated, connected, environmentally sustainable and safe, using training and the site-specific assessment methodology. In this outcome, UN Women will act to support the provincial and local government in the development of public works with a gender perspective and intersectionality in all phases of its cycle.
In the second outcome (By the end of 2023, the government of Neuquén has expanded capacities to promote, plan, project, budget and tender public works in the province using sustainability standards), UNOPS will work with the local government to implement concrete actions for the promotion of provincial public works with sustainability standards, particularly by training civil servants on sustainability related subjects in public works development and preparing guidelines to guide the province in the public procurement process integrating pursuit of climate action with other sustainable development objectives and enable coordination of multiple practitioners across the infrastructure lifecycle to establish, monitor, evaluate and, as necessary, adapt key objectives. Also, In this outcome, UN Women will support cities, local governments, provincial government agencies and interested individuals in the creation and promotion of gender-sensitive care infrastructures.
